# Unsloth AI

> > Unsloth AI - Open-source platform for 2-5x faster LLM fine-tuning with 70% less memory using optimized QLoRA, Flash Attention, and gradient checkpointing

Founded by Daniel and Michael, Unsloth became GitHub's #1 trending repository and is backed by YCombinator. The platform specializes in memory-efficient fine-tuning for models from Meta, Google, Alibaba, and Microsoft, with support for multi-GPU training, dynamic quantization (GGUF), and advanced techniques like GRPO reinforcement learning.

## Key Topics

- LLM fine-tuning and training optimization
- QLoRA (Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation)
- Memory optimization and VRAM efficiency
- Flash Attention 2 acceleration
- Model quantization and GGUF format
- Gradient checkpointing for long context
- Reasoning models (DeepSeek-R1, QwQ)
- Multi-GPU training support
- Hugging Face integration
- Vision and multimodal models
- Performance benchmarks on A100 GPUs
- Google Colab notebooks
- Bug fixes in gradient accumulation
- GRPO reinforcement learning
- Local inference optimization

## Latest Model Support

- [Llama 4 - Finetune & Run with Unsloth](https://unsloth.ai/blog/llama4): Fine-tune Meta's Llama 4 Scout & Maverick multimodal models with Unsloth
- [Run DeepSeek-R1 Dynamic 1.58-bit](https://unsloth.ai/blog/deepseekr1-dynamic): Run DeepSeek-R1 reasoning model with Unsloth's 1.58-bit dynamic GGUF
- [How to Run Deepseek-R1-0528 Locally](https://unsloth.ai/blog/deepseek-r1-0528): Run DeepSeek-R1-0528 & Qwen3-8B distill with 1.78-bit dynamic quants
- [How to Run Deepseek-V3-0324 Locally](https://unsloth.ai/blog/deepseek-v3-0324): Run DeepSeek-V3-0324 locally with Unsloth dynamic quantization
- [Fine-tune Llama 3.3 with Unsloth](https://unsloth.ai/blog/llama3-3): Fine-tune Meta's Llama 3.3 70B with Apple's Cut Cross Entropy algorithm
- [Finetune Llama 3.1 with Unsloth](https://unsloth.ai/blog/llama3-1): Fine-tune Meta's Llama 3.1 with 6x longer context lengths via Unsloth

- [Fine-tune Gemma 3 with Unsloth](https://unsloth.ai/blog/gemma3): Fine-tune Google's Gemma 3 multimodal models (1B-27B) with Unsloth
